integrity: Self-contained mathematical argument and executable integer checks supplied; finite checks supplement rather than replace proof; no independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proves only balancing, Lucas-balancing, Lucas-cobalancing squared-window gcd formulas; the cobalancing branch of the motivating question is not solved. The 2023 paper already observes parity and factor-three relations numerically. Earlier implicit published coverage cannot be categorically excluded.
title: Exact squared-window gcd laws for balancing and associated sequences
